title: Morton's orchestrations: Good Old New York and Climax Rag
summary: Carew shows Morton's manuscript scores, Morton's remark on arranging for ten or eleven instruments, and the Climax Rag studio arrangement.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
